The test passes.

I implemented the change request — a search box to filter the client list by name:

- Added a `client-search` input to the clients feature (`src/main/frontend/features/clients/ClientsPage.tsx`).
- It filters the already-loaded clients case-insensitively by name; an empty box shows all clients, matching the spec.

This stayed additive and local to the clients feature. No database or server changes were needed since the filter operates on the client data the page already loads via `/api/clients` — the test asserts purely on the client-side filtering behavior (`client-search`, `client-row-*`, `client-name`), all of which now pass.
